title: Final dataset expansion quality gate

roadmap_target.quality_condition: Expand only when useful, non-duplicative, source-backed bilingual knowledge can be added without reducing quality.

decision.summary: Keep the canonical dataset at 563 records. A mechanical expansion to approximately 700 would currently add more risk than verified knowledge.
reasons: The current dataset has category imbalance and category-label errors that should be corrected before adding more training examples.
The audit found semantically duplicated questions even though exact normalized English and Twi question checks pass.
Safety-sensitive pesticide, chemical, vaccination, medicine, and poisoning guidance needs agronomist or veterinary review before expansion.
New English guidance requires native-speaker review of every Twi question and answer; automatic translation is not an acceptable quality gate.

The active production bundle is checksum-bound to the 563-record dataset, so an unreviewed dataset mutation would correctly stop application startup until splitting, evaluation, training, and versioned activation are repeated.

category_error_examples.question_en: What is green manure and how do I use it?
What causes soil to become hard and how can I fix it?
My beans have rust disease. What should I do?
How do I calculate the profit from my farm?
How do I set up a brooder for day-old chicks?

semantic_overlap.method: English question word and bigram TF-IDF cosine similarity

safety_review.interpretation: Keyword flags are a review queue, not a claim that every flagged answer is wrong.

release_gates_before_any_future_addition: Resolve category-label errors and merge genuinely redundant records.
Attach authoritative source provenance to each proposed English answer.
Require agronomist or veterinary approval for safety-sensitive guidance.
Require native Twi review of every proposed question and answer.
Reject near-duplicate questions using semantic-overlap review, not exact matching alone.
Run the full TODO 20 validation workflow after changes.
Regenerate deterministic splits and complete TODO 21 retraining and evaluation.
Build and activate a new immutable semantic model version; never overwrite v1.0.1.
